title.zh: 将南苏里高省 Bislig 市 Bucto 描笼涯的 Bislig 市国立中学附属校分离，改设为独立的 Bucto 国立中学，并为此拨款
title.en: An Act Separating the Bislig City National High School - Bucto Annex in Barangay Bucto, City of Bislig, Province of Surigao Del Sur From the Bislig City National High School, Converting It Into An Independent National High School to Be Known as Bucto National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor

title.vi: Đạo luật tách Phân hiệu Bucto của Trường Trung học Thành phố Bislig Quốc gia tại Barangay Bucto, Thành phố Bislig, Tỉnh Surigao Del Sur khỏi Trường Trung học Thành phố Bislig Quốc gia và chuyển thành Trường Trung học Độc lập Quốc gia với tên gọi Trường Trung học Bucto Quốc gia, và bố trí kinh phí
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแยกวิทยาเขต Bucto ของโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเมือง Bislig แห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Bucto เมือง Bislig จังหวัด Surigao Del Sur ออกจากโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเมือง Bislig แห่งชาติและยกฐานะเป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาเอกเทศแห่งชาติชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Bucto แห่งชาติ และจัดสรรงบประมาณ
title.id: Undang-Undang Memisahkan Kampus Bucto, Sekolah Menengah Kota Bislig Nasional di Barangay Bucto, Kota Bislig, Provinsi Surigao Del Sur dari Sekolah Menengah Kota Bislig Nasional dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Mandiri Nasional dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bucto Nasional, dan mengalokasikan dana
title.ms: Akta Memisahkan Kampus Bucto, Sekolah Menengah Bandar Bislig Kebangsaan di Barangay Bucto, Bandar Bislig, Wilayah Surigao Del Sur daripada Sekolah Menengah Bandar Bislig Kebangsaan dan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Bebas Kebangsaan dengan nama Sekolah Menengah Bucto Kebangsaan, dan memperuntukkan dana

text.en: Separation and Conversion into an Independent National High School. – The Bislig City National High School – Bucto Annex (Annex VIII) situated in Barangay Bucto, City of Bislig, Province of Surigao del Sur is hereby separated from the Bislig City National High School and converted into an independent national high school to be known as Bucto National High School.

Transfer of Assets and Liabilities. – All personnel, assets, liabilities and records of the Bislig City National High School – Bucto Annex are hereby transferred to and absorbed by the Bucto National High School.

Appropriations. – The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Bucto National High School, the initial funding of which shall be charged against the current year’s appropriation of the Bislig City National High School – Bucto Annex. Thereafter, the amount necessary for the continued operation of the school shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
Implementation. – The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations that may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
